sprint_snapshot.objective: Implement UC-04 as specified in openspec/changes/uc-04-confirm-current-question/ (Focus/Live design, 4 Nov 2026): speech fills the Live question automatically, only Confirm question writes the exact displayed Live wording into the Focus question, and Reset live clears Live without changing Focus.
acceptance_criteria: Live: speech fills and refines the Live question automatically, including new questions, restatements, corrections and multipart wording, tagged "new question" or "restatement"; Live is never treated as confirmed and refills only from speech heard after the last Confirm question or Reset live.

Focus: only a successful Confirm question writes the Focus question; model output, silence, transcript finality and timers never do; Focus survives reflection and answers; the phase is QUESTION after Confirm; a confirmed restatement keeps the exchange and anything else starts a new one.

Confirmation: only the exact displayed Live id, version and text with the current Focus version is committed; stale, retired, altered, empty or already-focused requests leave Focus unchanged; retries are idempotent; the page shows Focus only after server acknowledgement; Stop and session boundaries clean up pending controls.

Tests: node --test poc/poc.test.mjs covers every scenario in the live-question, focus-question and question-confirmation specs, including the 4 Nov regression (after confirming Q1, a later Q2 appears only in Live while Focus stays Q1), and passes while preserving audio framing, origin checks and existing behavior.

Integration: a live run with only Pablo speaking is saved as docs/asdg/08-low-level-design/02-uc-04-verification.md with pass, fail or unverified per scenario and timings; the benchmark transcript and timestamps stay unchanged.
